## Set up

Choose a unit and the lesson's place in it; the planner fills the time with the unit's song, its LSA, and second-whole
activities from the book (a different selection for each lesson number). Change anything in **The plan** below.

```{=html}
<div class="lb-form">
  <label>Book <select id="lb-book"></select></label>
  <label>Unit <select id="lb-unit"></select></label>
  <label>Lesson in this unit <select id="lb-lesson"><option>1</option><option>2</option><option>3</option><option>4</option><option>5</option><option>6</option></select></label>
  <label>Class length <select id="lb-min"><option value="30">30 minutes</option><option value="45" selected>45 minutes</option><option value="60">60 minutes</option><option value="75">75 minutes</option></select></label>
  <label>LSA time <select id="lb-lsa"><option value="5" selected>5 minutes</option><option value="8">8 minutes</option><option value="10">10 minutes</option></select></label>
  <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" id="lb-build">Build the plan</button>
  <label>Or open <select id="lb-saved"></select></label>
  <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-secondary" id="lb-save">Save plan</button>
  <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-secondary" id="lb-del">Delete saved</button>
</div>
<p id="lb-summary" class="mlt-dim" aria-live="polite"></p>
```

```{=html}
<div class="lb-stage">

  <div class="lb-cols">
    <div class="lb-col"><h4>For you (teacher)</h4><div id="lb-teach"></div></div>
    <div class="lb-col"><h4>On the class screen</h4><div id="lb-stu"></div></div>
  </div>
  <div class="lb-ctl">
    <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-secondary" id="lb-back" disabled>◀ Back</button>
    <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" id="lb-play" disabled>▶ Start</button>
    <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-secondary" id="lb-skip" disabled>Next ▶</button>
    <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-secondary" id="lb-class">Open the class screen</button>
  </div>
  <div id="lb-next" class="lb-next"></div>
  <div id="lb-rec"></div>
</div>
```

## Classes and records

The LSA record sheet from Mullen pp. 83–84: a tonal chart and a rhythm chart for each class, a box beside each name. It
appears under the Run panel while the LSA is on. Kept in this browser only.

```{=html}
<div id="lb-classes"></div>
```

## The plan

Change the minutes, move items up or down, remove one, swap an activity for another from the unit, or add any activity from
the database. Save it to come back to it (saved in this browser).

```{=html}
<ol id="lb-list" class="lb-list"></ol>
```

## How it works {.mlt-t}

::: {.mlt-t}
- A plan follows Mullen's Whole-Part-Whole: a **first whole** (the unit's song), the **part** (the LSA: Pre-LSA, then a
  three-minute Go Mode), then **second-whole** activities that put the LSA's content back into music, a **bridge** to an
  inference skill when the unit has one, and a short close.
- Lesson numbers walk through the unit: lesson 2 takes the unit's next LSA (rhythm after tonal, as Mullen alternates) and a
  different set of activities.
- **The class screen** opens in a new window: drag it to the TV (an extended display). It shows only the students' side of the
  current item and the timer, and follows this window as you go. Both windows must be in the same browser.
- Planned next: an LSA record sheet (teaching mode | and evaluation mode +) for the class, kept with the plan.
:::

:::
